text:
sophia: thinking about a new console view — one that pins a per-route snapshot that includes per-model breakdown, routing policies in effect, and remaining quota. useful for on-call and SRE when something spikes

devin: love the idea. can we also overlay rollout flags? e.g., show which model variant a route is routed to during a canary

alan: can we get telemetry to surface model-level token counts? currently route-level only. need to ensure sampling doesn't bias the breakdown

marco: telemetry sampling is the blocker. if sampling is 1/10 we lose accuracy for low-traffic routes. maybe include a confidence metric in the UI (±%)

liz: UI question: saved views should include the filter + visual overlays (routing/quotas) or just the query? i worry about stale rollout links

sophia: want saved view to be a full snapshot by default (filters + overlays + timestamp). then offer a live mode that replays the same filters but with current state

devin: so two modes: Snapshot (frozen) and Live. Snapshot should store routing policy id + model versions; Live resolves model versions each load

alan: API-wise: /v1/console/analytics/views POST should accept {scope, filters, overlays, mode, pinned_at} — pinned_at for snapshot. quick sketch:```json
{
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "filters": [{"field":"latency","op":">","value":200}],
  "overlays": ["routing","quota"],
  "mode":"snapshot",
  "pinned_at":"2025-12-04T15:22:00Z"
}
```

marco: +1 but we need to be explicit about storing routing policy references not whole policy blob. store policy_id and model_variant_ids. otherwise snapshot will get huge

liz: and authz — saved snapshots might reference dedicated-only models. scope needs to be team/org/hidden. default to team-level for created views

devin: telemetry question again — when live mode loads a view we should show sampling rate in the header and a small tooltip that explains confidence. also expose raw query for SRE

qa-bot: quick check: if snapshot stores model_variant_ids, what happens on model deletion? should we show "deleted" badge or try to find compatible fallback?

alan: show badge + last-known performance. fallback mapping is product decision, but UI should surface the gap

console-bot: note created: draft API PR #842 by @alan referencing view snapshot schema :memo:

marco: UX: small bookmark star on route table to open saved view. also add a compare mode to show two views side-by-side (useful for rollout before/after)

liz: compare mode must be quota-aware: if one view shows quota exhausted, highlight affected requests and their fallback model

devin: implementation note: backend needs an index on (team_id, route_id, created_at) for fast lookup; and precompute per-view telemetry aggregates on snapshot creation to avoid heavy reads

sophia: action items:
- alan: draft API + storage schema (deadline Tue)
- marco: mockups for snapshot vs live vs compare (deadline Tue)
- devin: telemetry sampling proposal + confidence metric (deadline Wed)
- liz: authz scopes and default rules (deadline Wed)

marco: tagging design doc with /doc link in thread when ready :eyes:

liz: quick Q: do we want exported snapshot JSON (for audits)? I vote yes, include an export button that dumps the saved view and precomputed aggregates

devin: export + signed URL for SRE audits. keep retention policy aligned with analytics retention (default 90d)

sophia: all sounds good. will follow up with PR pointers and a short demo when mocks are done :thumbsup:
